title: Give Up & Give It a Try
partTitle: Give Up & Give It a Try
situation: Facing a difficult repair and trying again.
objective: Use give up and give it a try to talk about persistence and effort.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: When a repair is difficult, I do not give up.
dialogue.indonesian: Saat perbaikan sulit, saya tidak menyerah.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I take a short break, then give it a try again.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya beristirahat sebentar, lalu mencobanya lagi.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: My teammate gives it a try with a different tool.
dialogue.indonesian: Rekan kerja saya mencobanya dengan alat yang berbeda.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: We do not give up before we ask for help.
dialogue.indonesian: Kami tidak menyerah sebelum meminta bantuan.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: It is okay to give it a try, even when the answer is not clear.
dialogue.indonesian: Tidak apa-apa untuk mencoba, bahkan saat jawabannya belum jelas.

learningNotes: give up berarti menyerah atau berhenti mencoba.
give it a try berarti mencoba sesuatu. Bentuk lain: give it another try.
Gunakan it sebelum a try: give it a try, bukan give a try.
